title: Evidence-Based Architectural Learning for Future Builders
policy: Evidence-backed observations and reviewable recommendations only. Never treat lessons as task authorization, never mutate operational code or prompts automatically.

lessons.observation: ChatGPT GitHub event task runs reported missing source comment ID; GitHub Actions issue_comment events carried comment.id.
lessons.failure_pattern: Task wakes but cannot deterministically correlate its event to the source message.
lessons.future_builder_rule: Every intake must persist immutable source ID, provider delivery ID when available, time and content digest before processing; fail closed when identity is incomplete.
lessons.preflight_test: Given a payload without an unambiguous source ID, no processing or write occurs; normal payload must bind exact comment ID to a durable receipt.

lessons.observation: Genuine queue run 39032500246 failed at a GitHub API request with HTTP 403 despite workflow-declared permission; a subsequent genuine queue receipt was independently verified.
lessons.failure_pattern: Configured scopes and synthetic tests are mistaken for proof of a live server write.
lessons.future_builder_rule: Demand one scoped live permission proof and a durable per-attempt result receipt; distinguish API denial, unknown outcome and completed write. No blind retries.
lessons.preflight_test: Simulate 403, timeout and duplicate; confirm blocked outcome is retained and no duplicate write. Real write PASS requires confirmed read-back from GitHub.

lessons.observation: Android Termux gh binary existed but gh auth status was not logged in while an earlier Codex login had succeeded.
lessons.failure_pattern: Assuming one tool's authentication means another client, machine or plugin has authorization.
lessons.future_builder_rule: Maintain per-device, per-tool authentication capability states; do not request or export secrets and verify narrowly only when necessary.
lessons.preflight_test: Known Codex sign-in does not satisfy gh-auth precondition; report independently UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED.

lessons.observation: An AAB main chat hit its conversation length limit; durable GitHub resume records and phone-state ledger preserved recovery state.
lessons.failure_pattern: Agent restarts from stale conversation memory or repeats already passed checks.
lessons.future_builder_rule: On restart load current repo, branch, commit, owner-approved scope, latest tests, capability ledger, STOP flag and unresolved conflicts before acting.
lessons.preflight_test: Supply deliberately stale commit and contradictory checkpoint; require UNVERIFIED/BLOCKED without code changes.

lessons.observation: AAB Doctor passed 18 independent tests in a separate reviewer environment but had not been executed on the owner's Android Termux.
lessons.failure_pattern: Equating independent Linux test PASS with device readiness or production completion.
lessons.future_builder_rule: Label each gate separately: source integrity, local unit tests, CI, on-target smoke, security/recovery and deployment. Never imply later gates are passed.
lessons.preflight_test: A report with off-device PASS and phone UNVERIFIED cannot be promoted to phone-ready COMPLETED.

lessons.observation: Pocket Task Board CI completed 8 frozen acceptance tests successfully using GitHub Actions, offloading routine repeatable verification from conversational agents.
lessons.failure_pattern: Manual AI review of repeatable deterministic tests wastes time and may create inconsistent verdicts.
lessons.future_builder_rule: Route deterministic tests to a fixed, bounded, least-privilege CI job; reserve AI for architecture, ambiguity and independent result interpretation.
lessons.preflight_test: Source/test changes trigger bounded CI; unrelated discussion or planning changes do not trigger repeat app tests.
